summary: Wrote dft/dft_plan.md covering test strategy, scan approach (full mux-D scan, 1 or 4 chains over an expected 529 flops), proposed test pins (scan_en, scan_in, scan_out, optional test_mode; not yet in spec), coverage method (Phase 1 ATPG with stuck-at and transition-delay, no number claimed), memory test (flop storage covered by scan, no MBIST needed, optional March-style functional test), and limitations of the OpenLane 2 Classic flow. No scan inserted, no tool run, no coverage claimed.
assumptions: Flop count of 529 (512 storage + 5 wr_ptr + 5 rd_ptr + 5 count + overflow + underflow) is derived from arch.yaml, not counted from the netlist.
Mission mode holds scan_en at 0; launch-on-capture is used for transition test because scan_en is not expected to be timed at speed.
No latches, tri-states or combinational loops exist in the netlist, inferred from the architecture; must be confirmed by Phase 1 DFT DRC.
sky130_fd_sc_hd provides usable mux-D scan flop cells (sdfxtp family); to be confirmed against the liberty file in Phase 1.
open_issues: Chain count (1 vs 4) depends on the pin budget; human decision needed.
Phase 0 die has no structural test; its manufacturing test coverage is unmeasured.
Scan muxes and scan_en buffering will reduce timing slack (worst pre-layout setup slack 0.306 ns at nom_ss_100C_1v60); impact must be measured once a scan-capable flow exists.
Spec has no test pins. Adding scan_en, scan_in, scan_out (and optionally test_mode) needs a spec change and G1 human approval; DFT has not added them.

self_assessment.reason: Plan-only deliverable with all six sections, grounded in the given inputs; no tool results or coverage numbers are claimed.
